newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
British MP David Cox urges British companies to do more business in Sri Lanka.
Tamil rebels overrun police post in Medirigiriya, kill 20 policemen and home guards.
LTTE's Voice of Tigers radio station based in Thoppigala jungles destroyed in army artillery strike.
Sajith Premadasa, son of slain president Ranasinghe Premadasa, appointed opposition United National Party organiser for Hambantota district.
Army chief Lt. General Rohan Daluwatte says closing date for new recruits to join army extended till October 31 because of growing response from youth.
